Hospital Medical Representative (MR) Pass Booking System

1. Purpose of This Document

This document is a complete, end-to-end developer guide to design, build, deploy, and maintain a fair online hospital pass booking system for Medical Representatives (MRs).

The system is designed to:

Eliminate physical queues

Prevent the same MR from getting passes on continuous days

Handle 100+ MRs competing for limited daily passes

Ensure transparency, fairness, and auditability


This guide is written so any developer or development team can directly implement the system.


---

2. High-Level System Overview

Actors

Medical Representative (MR)

Hospital Security

Hospital Admin

System (Automated Engine)


Core Modules

1. MR Registration & Verification


2. Daily Pass Application Window


3. Eligibility & Blocking Engine


4. Weighted Lottery Selection Engine


5. Notification System (SMS/App)


6. Gate Verification System


7. Admin Dashboard


8. Audit & Reporting Module




---

3. Technology Stack (Recommended)

Frontend

Mobile Web App (PWA) or Android App

Frameworks: React / React Native / Flutter


Backend

Node.js (Express / NestJS)

OR Supabase (PostgreSQL + Edge Functions)


Database

PostgreSQL


Authentication

OTP-based login (Mobile Number)


Notifications

SMS Gateway (Dialog / Mobitel / Twilio)

Optional Push Notifications


Hosting

Vercel / Firebase / Supabase / AWS



---

4. Database Design (Core Tables)

4.1 Medical Representatives Table

medical_reps
- id (UUID, PK)
- full_name
- company_name
- mr_id
- mobile_number
- status (active / suspended)
- created_at


---

4.2 Hospitals Table

hospitals
- id (UUID, PK)
- name
- daily_pass_limit (default: 15)
- booking_window_start (18:00)
- booking_window_end (18:10)


---

4.3 Daily Applications Table

pass_applications
- id (UUID, PK)
- mr_id (FK)
- hospital_id (FK)
- application_date
- priority_score
- status (applied / selected / waitlisted / rejected)
- created_at


---

4.4 Pass Issuance Table

issued_passes
- id (UUID, PK)
- mr_id (FK)
- hospital_id (FK)
- pass_date
- time_slot
- qr_code
- entry_status (not_entered / entered / expired)


---

4.5 Entry Logs Table

entry_logs
- id (UUID, PK)
- issued_pass_id (FK)
- entry_time
- verified_by


---

5. MR Registration Flow

1. MR enters mobile number


2. OTP verification


3. MR submits:

Full Name

Company Name

MR ID



4. Admin verifies (optional)


5. MR account activated



Duplicate MR IDs or mobile numbers must be blocked.


---

6. Daily Booking Window Logic

Rule

Booking opens daily from 6:00 PM – 6:10 PM

Unlimited applications accepted

No instant confirmation


API Logic

Validate booking window

Allow only one application per MR per hospital per day



---

7. Eligibility & Blocking Engine (Critical)

Blocking Rule

If MR entered hospital today, then:

Block MR for next 2 days


Eligibility Check

Before lottery:

Check last entry date

Check missed entries

Check suspension status


Ineligible MRs are excluded automatically.


---

8. Priority Score Calculation

Each MR receives a priority score daily.

Example Logic

No pass in last 14 days → +5

No pass in last 7 days → +3

Got pass in last 3 days → -5

Missed confirmed entry → -10


Priority score stored in pass_applications table.


---

9. Lottery Selection Engine

Execution Time

Automatically triggered at 6:10 PM


Steps

1. Fetch all eligible applications


2. Sort by priority score (descending)


3. Take top priority pool


4. Randomly select daily_pass_limit MRs


5. Remaining go to waitlist



This guarantees fairness and rotation.


---

10. Pass Confirmation & QR Generation

For each selected MR:

Generate unique QR code

Assign time slot

Insert record into issued_passes

Send SMS/App notification


QR must contain:

Pass ID

Date

Hospital ID



---

11. Time Slot Assignment

Example:

Slot 1: 9:00–10:00 (5 MRs)

Slot 2: 10:00–11:00 (5 MRs)

Slot 3: 11:00–12:00 (5 MRs)


Slot allocation is automatic and balanced.


---

12. Hospital Gate Verification

Security Flow

1. MR shows QR code


2. Security scans OR manually enters Pass ID


3. System validates:

Correct date

Correct hospital

Not already used



4. Entry logged




---

13. Auto-Cancellation & Waitlist Promotion

Rule

If MR does not enter before end of slot:

Pass expires

Next waitlisted MR promoted



System sends automatic SMS update.


---

14. Admin Dashboard Features

Admin can:

Set daily pass limits

View applications

View selected & waitlist

Block/suspend MR

Export reports


Dashboard must be simple and non-technical.


---

15. Security & Abuse Prevention

One device per MR (optional)

QR single-use only

Entry logging mandatory

Automatic penalties for misuse



---

16. Deployment Steps

1. Setup database


2. Deploy backend APIs


3. Deploy frontend app


4. Configure SMS gateway


5. Configure cron jobs


6. Conduct pilot testing




---

17. Maintenance & Scaling

System supports multiple hospitals

Pass limits configurable

Can scale to 1000+ MRs



---

18. Final Outcome

This system:

Removes chaos

Ensures fairness

Prevents continuous access abuse

Saves hospital staff time

Creates trust among MRs



---

19. Next Developer Tasks

Convert rules to code

Create API documentation

Build UI screens

Run live pilot

**Developing the System Concept**

Okay, I'm working on the Hospital MR Pass Booking System. Currently, I'm visualizing the mobile login with OTP and registration details (name, company, MR ID). I've got the 6 PM to 6:10 PM daily time slot, and the non-instant confirmation idea. I'm also ensuring the system blocks continuous day bookings.


**Defining the Selection Process**

I've finalized the selection process. It's a weighted lottery at 6:10 PM, considering past booking frequency and missed entries to determine MR priority. Once selected, a QR code is generated for each successful booking, specifying the time slot. I am also working on the admin dashboard, and considering the security/gate view and how QR codes will be scanned.

🔄 SYSTEM UPDATE EXPLANATION

ONE APPLICATION – MULTIPLE HOSPITALS – APPROVAL BASED ACCESS

This update changes the system from
❌ one hospital = one app
to
✅ one app that supports all hospitals


---

1️⃣ Core Update (What Changed)

OLD IDEA (Wrong)

Separate app for each hospital

Separate login

Separate rules

Not scalable


NEW UPDATE (Correct)

ONE single application

ALL hospitals listed inside

Access controlled by hospital approval


This is the foundation.


---

2️⃣ How Hospitals Exist in the App

From developer perspective:

There is a master hospitals table

Every hospital is a record in that table

Each hospital has:

Its own rules

Its own admin

Its own pass limit



But all hospitals live inside one system.


---

3️⃣ Approval Is the Key (Most Important Part)

Just because a hospital exists in the app
➡️ does NOT mean every MR can apply.

New Rule:

> An MR can apply to a hospital ONLY if that hospital approves the MR



This approval is stored in a mapping table.


---

4️⃣ MR–Hospital Approval Logic (Simple)

Think like this:

MR = User

Hospital = Resource

Approval = Permission


Table logic:

MR ID

Hospital ID

Status = approved / pending / rejected


If:

status = approved → MR can apply

status ≠ approved → MR cannot apply



---

5️⃣ What MR Sees in the App (UI Logic)

When MR logs in:

1. System checks approval table


2. App shows:

✅ Hospitals where status = approved

❌ Others hidden or disabled




So the MR:

Cannot even see “Apply” button for unapproved hospitals

Cannot flood all hospitals



---

6️⃣ Application Flow (After This Update)

For MR:

1. Login once (single app)


2. Select approved hospital


3. Apply for pass


4. System applies hospital-specific rules



For developer:

Same flow

Just filtered by hospital approval



---

7️⃣ Hospital Control (Why Admins Will Accept This)

Each hospital:

Approves only their allowed MRs

Sets their own booking time

Sets their own daily pass limit

Runs their own lottery


But still:

No separate app

No separate backend



---

8️⃣ Important Developer Rules (Must Follow)

❌ Do NOT allow MR to apply without approval

❌ Do NOT show all hospitals to all users

✅ Always filter hospitals by approval table

✅ Treat every hospital as isolated inside the same system



---

9️⃣ Final One-Line Explanation to Developer

> “Build one application where all hospitals exist, but MRs can only see and apply to hospitals that have approved them.”




---

10️⃣ Final Result of This Update

✔ One app
✔ Clean UX
✔ Hospital-level control
✔ No misuse
✔ Easy to scale across Colombo / Sri Lanka

**Refining Hospital Support**

Okay, I'm currently focused on improving the multi-hospital support. Specifically, I'm digging into how to refine the `mr_hospital_approvals` structure. I need a way to manage which medical representatives can book at which hospitals. It's a new element to be integrated with `medical_reps` and `hospitals`.


**Implementing Access Controls**

I've progressed to implementing access control measures. I'm adding `getApprovals` and `saveApprovals` methods to `storageService.ts` and initializing demo approvals. I'm also planning to create a new `MRHospitalApproval` type within `types.ts` to manage this new functionality. The `MRDashboard.tsx` will filter hospitals based on the approval status, and it will also add a list of hospitals where access can be requested.

This update adds time-based passes (Morning / Evening / Full Day) while keeping fairness.


---

Each hospital can configure how passes are issued per day.

Hospital Setup Options

Hospital admin can choose one of these models:

1. Morning only


2. Evening only


3. Morning + Evening


4. Whole Day pass only



This setup is done once (or editable by hospital admin).


---

2️⃣ Pass Session Definition (Developer)

Each pass belongs to a session:

MORNING

EVENING

FULL_DAY


This must be stored with every issued pass.

pass_date = 2026-11-01
session = MORNING


---

3️⃣ MR Application Flow (IMPORTANT)

What MR Sees

When MR selects a hospital:

System shows:

Available sessions for that hospital for that date

Example:

☀ Morning Pass

🌙 Evening Pass




MR can only apply to visible sessions.


---

4️⃣ Lottery Runs PER SESSION (NOT PER DAY)

This is critical.

Example:

If hospital has:

Morning (15 passes)

Evening (15 passes)


Then:

Morning lottery = separate

Evening lottery = separate


Hospital admin runs:

Morning lottery → selects winners

Evening lottery → selects winners



---

5️⃣ 3-DAY RESTRICTION RULE (SESSION-AWARE)

This is where your logic is smart and fair.

Rule Explained Simply

❌ MR is blocked for 3 days ONLY for the SAME session type

✅ MR can still apply for a different session


---

6️⃣ Exact Scenarios (VERY IMPORTANT)

✅ Case 1: Morning → Morning

MR gets Morning pass on Nov 1

MR tries Morning pass on Nov 2, 3, 4

❌ BLOCKED

MR can apply again on Nov 5 Morning



---

✅ Case 2: Morning → Evening

MR gets Morning pass on Nov 1

MR applies for Evening pass on Nov 2

✅ ALLOWED (if hospital has evening session)


Why?
Because Morning ≠ Evening


---

❌ Case 3: Full Day Pass

MR gets Full Day pass on Nov 1

MR tries ANY session on Nov 2, 3, 4

❌ BLOCKED

Eligible again on Nov 5


Full Day blocks all sessions.


---

When MR applies:

1. Identify:

Hospital ID

Requested session (Morning / Evening / Full Day)



2. Check pass history:

Same hospital

Last 3 days

Compare session rules

Last Pass	Applying For	Allowed

Morning	Morning	❌
Morning	Evening	✅
Evening	Evening	❌
Evening	Morning	✅
Full Day	Any	❌



---

Chooses:

Session types

Pass count per session


Runs lottery per session

3-day rule

Eligibility filters

Date

Hospital

Session (Morning / Evening / Full Day)

Status (Won / Lost)


This keeps system transparent.

✔ No same MR dominating slots
✔ Hospitals with flexible schedules supported
✔ Real-world workflow matches hospital reality
✔ No manual favoritism

❌ Cannot contact companies

Mark invoices as paid / unpaid

✔ No hospital involvement in money

Hospital creation without Super Admin

Hospital admin rule modification

Billing without Super Admin approval

Role	Can Do
